title: Blinding Truth Operation Veil
description: A man in a dark military uniform sits at a wooden desk covered in classified documents, diagrams of celestial objects, and papers labeled 'Blinding Truth'. He holds a remote control while looking at the papers. Through an open door labeled 'OPERATION: VEIL', a silhouetted figure stands in yellow light. Above, a massive glowing celestial body with rings emits bright light rays into a starry sky with flying birds.
